hero.description: I build fast, responsive and visually engaging interfaces with React and Tailwind CSS. I care about clean code and a smooth experience in every project.

about.label: ABOUT ME
about.who_desc: For me, frontend development is not just about writing code; it’s about creating something user-friendly for people. While studying at Mars IT School, I work on real-world projects using React, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript. I derive the greatest satisfaction from transforming a complex idea into a simple, beautiful interface.

values.clean_desc: I write modular, easy-to-read code that is simple to extend in the future.
values.responsive_desc: The same quality experience from small phones to large monitors.
values.performance_desc: Lightweight interfaces, fast loading and smooth animations.

skills.label: SKILLS
skills.subtitle: Technologies I learn every day and use in practice. The core stack is React, Tailwind CSS and JavaScript.
skills.core_desc: Levels are based on hands-on project experience.

projects.label: PROJECTS
projects.subtitle: Real projects built through practice. Each one is responsive and built with a modern stack.

dachahub.title: DachaHub
dachahub.desc: A modern platform to discover, explore and book the best dachas and vacation stays across Uzbekistan.

turarzone.title: TurarZone
turarzone.desc: A student-focused platform that helps students quickly find affordable housing and rental options.

supabase.title: React Tailwind Supabase
supabase.desc: A modern starter stack with authentication, database and ready-made UI components.

experience.label: EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION
experience.subtitle: My journey through learning, practice and real projects.

freelance.title: Junior Frontend Developer
freelance.desc: Built web platforms such as DachaHub and TurarZone with React and Tailwind CSS: interface architecture, components, responsive layouts and deployment.

mars.title: Frontend Development
mars.desc: Intensive study of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React fundamentals. Components, state, routing, working with APIs and modern UI practices.

self.title: Web fundamentals
self.desc: Started with HTML and CSS, then learned responsive layouts and Git workflows. I keep learning new technologies every day.
